summary: ACCEPT at 0 blockers, 0 MUST-FIX, and 0 SHOULD-FIX. The v5 successor preserves the seven-obligation G15 partition and sole local leftoverDesign item OBL-AT-FX-AUTHORING. G15 v4 remains current at draft time and becomes historical only after successor recording; occupancy v9 remains current; packaging-leftover-join.v4 remains current on DR-120; component-manifest-leftover-join.v6 remains current on DR-103. The successor removes the predecessorV3 this-v4 speaker, uses the v5 speaker at predecessorV4, family-qualifies packaging v3/v4, and pins D-269 solely as last-heading custody. It creates no fixture, adapter, threshold, SATISFIED, occupancy, file-08, or implementation authority and steals none of the DR-120 or DR-103 leftovers.
discipline: Attempted to falsify subject custody, strict syntax, recorded-input closure, family-qualified lineage currency, speaker succession, obligation arithmetic, frozen-input standing, live register state, and authority boundaries. Acceptance follows only because every dispatch and independent attack was refuted on pinned bytes.
